record.original_question: How are Herman rings created or destroyed when a rational or transcendental map is perturbed, and what is the structure and size of the parameter sets in natural families for which Herman rings occur?

evidence.quote: The behavior of Herman rings under perturbations of the underlying map is not well understood. In particular, the mechanisms by which Herman rings are created or destroyed in parameter space remain to be clarified. Also, the structure and size of the set of parameters corresponding to maps with Herman rings in natural families of rational and transcendental maps are still largely unknown.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f_\lambda : \widehat{\mathbb{C}} \to \widehat{\mathbb{C}}$ be a holomorphic family of rational maps (or, more generally, of transcendental meromorphic maps $f_\lambda : \mathbb{C} \to \widehat{\mathbb{C}}$) depending holomorphically on a parameter $\lambda$ in some complex manifold $\Lambda$. Recall that a Herman ring of $f_\lambda$ is a periodic Fatou component $U$ of period $p \geq 1$ that is conformally isomorphic to a round annulus $A_r = \{z : 1 < |z| < r\}$ via a conformal map $\varphi : U \to A_r$ that conjugates $f_\lambda^p|_U$ to an irrational rotation $z \mapsto e^{2\pi i \alpha} z$ of $A_r$ for some $\alpha \in \mathbb{R} \setminus \mathbb{Q}$.

Address the following:

(a) Describe the bifurcation mechanisms by which Herman rings are created and destroyed under perturbation of $\lambda$. In particular, identify the local dynamical phenomena (e.g., collisions of boundary components with the postsingular set, parabolic implosions, quasiconformal surgeries, breakdowns of invariant curves) responsible for the appearance or disappearance of a Herman ring as $\lambda$ varies, and give a classification of such bifurcations.

(b) For a given natural holomorphic family $\{f_\lambda\}_{\lambda \in \Lambda}$ (for example, the family of degree-$d$ Blaschke-product-like rational maps with a fixed rotation number, the complex standard family $f_\lambda(z) = \lambda z \exp\!\left(\tfrac{a}{2}(z - 1/z)\right)$, or natural families of transcendental meromorphic maps), determine the topological structure, measure-theoretic size (Lebesgue measure, Hausdorff dimension), and analytic properties (e.g., quasi-conformal rigidity, density, accessibility) of the set
$$\mathcal{H}(\{f_\lambda\}) = \{\lambda \in \Lambda : f_\lambda \text{ has a Herman ring}\}.$$
In particular, determine whether $\mathcal{H}$ has positive Lebesgue measure, whether it has nonempty interior, and how its slices by rotation number compare with the corresponding Arnold tongue structure of the associated circle dynamics.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent surveys and research on Herman rings explicitly identify the perturbation behavior of Herman rings and the structure/size of the parameter set producing them in natural families as not well understood. Partial results exist (Shishikura's quasiconformal surgery, Arnold disks for the complex standard family, recent constructions of nested and higher-period Herman rings, non-existence results for certain meromorphic maps with omitted values), but the general question of bifurcation mechanisms and the measure-theoretic/topological structure of the Herman-ring parameter locus remains open.

status_evidence.title: Herman Rings: Structure, Dynamics, and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: The behavior of Herman rings under perturbations of the underlying map is not well understood... the structure and size of the set of parameters corresponding to maps with Herman rings in natural families of rational and transcendental maps are still largely unknown.
status_evidence.claim: Survey explicitly lists these questions as open.

status_evidence.title: Arnold Disks and the Moduli of Herman Rings of the Complex Standard Family
status_evidence.snippet: Study of the parameter set of Herman rings in the complex standard family via Arnold disks.
status_evidence.claim: Partial parameter-space results exist for specific families.

status_evidence.title: Rational maps with smooth degenerate Herman rings
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of rational maps with degenerate Herman rings via perturbation/surgery.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results on perturbative creation of Herman rings.

status_evidence.title: Herman rings of meromorphic maps with an omitted value
status_evidence.snippet: Non-existence results for Herman rings in certain meromorphic families.
status_evidence.claim: Partial structural results for transcendental families.
